purpose: Local upload -> durable import and Gemma indexing -> text retrieval -> source-frame checks -> timestamp playback. Engineering acceptance check, not a benchmark.
source_annotation_note: Public 22-second robot-coffee recording; labels are provisional and not independently reviewed.

regression_tests.warning_note: Existing SentencePiece Swig type deprecation warnings.

quality_limits: Two description windows have empty action/object lists despite descriptive summaries.
Negative answers returned no_match with literal insufficient_evidence observations. Preserve this conflict; do not treat expected statuses as full semantic correctness.
The UI checks up to three retrieved intervals with eight frames each, not every frame of the full video.
Speech search, reliable event counts and broad archive answer synthesis remain unimplemented.
No CCTV benchmark accuracy or production load claim. Two GiB upload ceiling is configured but a multi-gigabyte live upload was not run.
implementation_notes: Hosted Gemma uses named identity, strict JSON schema, reasoning none, helper add-ons off and 600-second request timeout. Model redirects are rejected.
Schema v4 persists the desired index spec on browser imports; import and child-index enqueue commit together.
Uploads use a separate persistent volume, read-only to worker and source readers, writable only at the API upload mount.
Internal /__uploads/ marker cannot collide with relative library paths. One in-development demo path was corrected explicitly with database backup; three original records stayed unchanged.

description.summary: The provided frames show a robotic arm moving a clear plastic cup from a position on the right side of the table to a drip tray of a coffee machine between 16.38s and 20.14s. From 20.88s to 21.64s, the robotic arm moves away from the coffee machine. A second robotic gripper remains stationary on the left side of the table throughout the sequence.

The provided frames show a robotic arm interacting with a coffee machine and a plastic cup on a black surface. From 8.64s to 11.14s, a robotic gripper holds a coffee pod and places it into the coffee machine. By 12.38s, the pod is inserted, and the gripper moves away. From 13.64s to 16.14s, the gripper remains stationary while another robotic arm on the right begins to move. At 17.38s, the right robotic arm moves toward the plastic cup.
uncertainties: The exact nature of the white strip on the table is unclear.

description.summary: The video shows two robotic arms interacting with a small circular object on a black surface. From 0.64s to 4.38s, the arms move toward and grasp the circular object. At 5.64s, the right arm moves away while the left arm holds the object. By 8.14s, the left arm moves the object toward a silver machine at the top of the frame, and by 9.38s, it positions the object near the machine's opening.
uncertainties: The exact nature of the circular object is unclear.
